sentences.zh: 733 二十一年 置福建經略使，領福、泉、建、漳、潮五州，治福州。

translations.literal: 733, twenty-first year. The Fujian frontier commissioner was established, holding Fu, Quan, Jian, Zhang, and Chao prefectures—five in all—with seat at Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 733, the twenty-first year of Kaiyuan, a Fujian frontier commissioner was appointed, commanding Fu, Quan, Jian, Zhang, and Chao from his seat at Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 734 二十二年 福建經略使增領汀州，漳、潮二州隸嶺南道經略使。

translations.literal: 734, twenty-second year. The Fujian frontier commissioner added Ting Prefecture to its jurisdiction; Zhang and Chao prefectures were placed under the Lingnan circuit frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 734, the Fujian frontier commissioner gained Ting Prefecture, while Zhang and Chao were transferred to the Lingnan circuit frontier commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: In 742, the first year of Tianbao, the Fujian frontier commissioner regained jurisdiction over Zhang and Chao.

translations.idiomatic: In 751, the tenth year of Tianbao, Zhang and Chao were assigned to the Lingnan frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 756 至德元載 置淮南節度使，領揚、楚、滁、和、壽、廬、舒、光、蘄、安、黃、申、沔十三州，治揚州。

translations.literal: 756, first year of the Zhide era. The Huainan circuit military commissioner was established, holding Yang, Chu, Chu, He, Shou, Lu, Shu, Guang, Qi, An, Huang, Shen, and Mian prefectures—thirteen in all—with seat at Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 756, the first year of Zhide, a Huainan circuit military commissioner was created, commanding thirteen prefectures—Yang, Chu, Chu, He, Shou, Lu, Shu, Guang, Qi, An, Huang, Shen, and Mian—from his seat at Yang Prefecture.

translations.literal: Soon Guang Prefecture was placed under the Huaixi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward Guang Prefecture was assigned to the Huaixi circuit.

sentences.zh: 757 二載 置劍南東川節度使，領梓、遂、綿、劍、龍、閬、普、陵、瀘、榮、資、簡十二州，治梓州。

translations.literal: 757, second year. The Jiannan East Chuan circuit military commissioner was established, holding Zi, Sui, Mian, Jian, Long, Lang, Pu, Ling, Lu, Rong, Zi, and Jian prefectures—twelve in all—with seat at Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 757, the second year of Zhide, a Jiannan East Chuan military commissioner was appointed, commanding twelve prefectures—Zi, Sui, Mian, Jian, Long, Lang, Pu, Ling, Lu, Rong, Zi, and Jian—from his seat at Zi Prefecture.

translations.literal: A Jiangdong defense commissioner was established, with seat at Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiangdong defense commissioner was installed, headquartered at Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 758 乾元元年 置浙江西道節度兼江寧軍使，領昇、潤、宣、歙、饒、江、蘇、常、杭、湖十州，治昇州，尋徙治蘇州，未幾，罷領宣、歙、饒三州，副使兼餘杭軍使，治杭州。

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era. The Zhejiang West circuit commissioner concurrently holding the Jiangning Army commissioner post was established, holding Sheng, Run, Xuan, She, Rao, Jiang, Su, Chang, Hang, and Hu prefectures—ten in all—with seat at Sheng Prefecture; soon the seat was moved to Su Prefecture; before long, jurisdiction over Xuan, She, and Rao prefectures was discontinued; the deputy commissioner concurrently held the Yuhang Army commissioner post, with seat at Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 758, the first year of Qianyuan, a Zhejiang West circuit commissioner was created who also served as Jiangning Army commissioner, commanding ten prefectures—Sheng, Run, Xuan, She, Rao, Jiang, Su, Chang, Hang, and Hu—from his seat at Sheng Prefecture. The seat was soon moved to Su Prefecture; before long Xuan, She, and Rao were removed from his command, while the deputy commissioner took the Yuhang Army commissioner post at Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置浙江東道節度使，領越、睦、衢、婺、臺、明、處、溫八州，治越州。

translations.literal: A Zhejiang East circuit military commissioner was established, holding Yue, Mu, Qu, Wu, Tai, Ming, Chu, and Wen prefectures—eight in all—with seat at Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhejiang East circuit military commissioner was appointed, commanding eight prefectures—Yue, Mu, Qu, Wu, Tai, Ming, Chu, and Wen—from his seat at Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改福建經略使為都防禦使兼寧海軍使。

translations.literal: The Fujian frontier commissioner was changed to chief defense commissioner concurrently holding the Ninghai Army commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian frontier commissioner was redesignated chief defense commissioner, concurrently serving as Ninghai Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置洪吉都防禦團練觀察處置使兼莫傜軍使，領洪、吉、虔、撫、袁五州，治洪州。

translations.literal: The Hong-Ji chief defense, training, observation, and disposal commissioner concurrently holding the Mo Yao Army commissioner post was established, holding Hong, Ji, Qian, Fu, and Yuan prefectures—five in all—with seat at Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Hong–Ji chief defense, training, observation, and disposal commissioner was installed who also served as Mo Yao Army commissioner, commanding Hong, Ji, Qian, Fu, and Yuan from his seat at Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置宣歙饒觀察使，治宣州。

translations.literal: The Xuan-She-Rao observation commissioner was established, with seat at Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An Xuan–She–Rao observation commissioner was appointed, headquartered at Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 759 二年 劍南東川增領昌、渝、合三州。

translations.literal: 759, second year. Jiannan East Chuan added Chang, Yu, and He prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 759, the second year of Qianyuan, Jiannan East Chuan gained jurisdiction over Chang, Yu, and He prefectures.

sentences.zh: 沔州隸鄂岳節度，壽州隸淮西節度。

translations.literal: Mian Prefecture was placed under the E-Yue circuit; Shou Prefecture under the Huaixi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Mian Prefecture was assigned to the E–Yue circuit, and Shou Prefecture to the Huaixi circuit.

sentences.zh: 廢浙江西道節度使，置觀察處置都團練守捉及本道營田使，更領丹陽軍使，治蘇州，復領宣、歙、饒三州。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang West circuit military commissioner was abolished; an observation, disposal, chief training, garrison, and the circuit's farm commissioner was established, additionally taking charge of the Danyang Army commissioner post, with seat at Su Prefecture; Xuan, She, and Rao prefectures were again placed under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang West circuit military commissioner was abolished and replaced by an observation, disposal, chief training, and garrison commissioner who also supervised the circuit's farming operations and held the Danyang Army commissioner post at Su Prefecture; Xuan, She, and Rao were restored to his command.

translations.literal: The Xuan-She-Rao observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuan–She–Rao observation commissioner was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 置鄂、岳、沔三州都團練守捉使，治鄂州。

translations.literal: A chief training and garrison commissioner for E, Yue, and Mian prefectures was established, with seat at E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A chief training and garrison commissioner for E, Yue, and Mian prefectures was installed, headquartered at E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 760 上元元年 升福建都防禦使為節度使。

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era. The Fujian chief defense commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 760, the first year of Shangyuan, the Fujian chief defense commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

translations.literal: The Hong-Ji observation commissioner added Xin Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Hong–Ji observation commissioner gained jurisdiction over Xin Prefecture.

translations.literal: Yue Prefecture was placed under the Jingnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Prefecture was transferred to the Jingnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 761 二年 浙江西道觀察使徙治宣州，罷領昇州。

translations.literal: 761, second year. The Zhejiang West circuit observation commissioner moved his seat to Xuan Prefecture and discontinued jurisdiction over Sheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 761, the Zhejiang West observation commissioner relocated to Xuan Prefecture and relinquished Sheng Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Hangzhou prefect concurrently held the defense commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The Hangzhou prefect also served as defense commissioner.

translations.literal: 762, first year of the Baoying era.
translations.idiomatic: 762 CE, first year of the Baoying reign.

translations.literal: 763, first year of the Guangde era.
translations.idiomatic: 763 CE, first year of the Guangde reign.

sentences.zh: 764 二年 廢東川節度，以所管十五州隸西川節度。

translations.literal: 764, second year. The East Chuan circuit was abolished; its fifteen prefectures were placed under the West Chuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 764, the East Chuan circuit was abolished and its fifteen prefectures were assigned to the West Chuan circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪吉都防禦團練觀察使更號江南西道。

translations.literal: The Hong-Ji chief defense, training, and observation commissioner was redesignated Jiangnan West circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hong–Ji chief defense, training, and observation commissioner was retitled the Jiangnan West circuit.

sentences.zh: 765 永泰元年 蘄、黃二州隸鄂岳節度。

translations.literal: 765, first year of the Yongtai era. Qi and Huang prefectures were placed under the E-Yue circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 765, the first year of Yongtai, Qi and Huang prefectures were transferred to the E–Yue circuit.

sentences.zh: 升鄂州都團練使為觀察使，增領岳、蘄、黃三州。

translations.literal: The E Prefecture chief training commissioner was promoted to observation commissioner, adding Yue, Qi, and Huang prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The E Prefecture chief training commissioner was raised to observation commissioner, gaining jurisdiction over Yue, Qi, and Huang.

sentences.zh: 766 大曆元年 復置劍南東川節度使，領州如故。

translations.literal: 766, first year of the Dali era. The Jiannan East Chuan circuit military commissioner was again established, holding the same prefectures as before.
translations.idiomatic: In 766, the first year of Dali, the Jiannan East Chuan military commissioner was restored with the same prefectures as before.

sentences.zh: 浙江西道觀察使罷領宣、歙二州。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang West circuit observation commissioner discontinued jurisdiction over Xuan and She prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang West observation commissioner relinquished Xuan and She prefectures.

sentences.zh: 復置宣歙池等州都團練守捉觀察處置使兼採石軍使。

translations.literal: The Xuan-She-Chi and related prefectures chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner concurrently holding the Caishi Army commissioner post was again established.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuan–She–Chi chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner, also serving as Caishi Army commissioner, was restored.

sentences.zh: 767 二年 廢劍南東川節度，置都防禦觀察使兼靜戎軍使，治遂州。

translations.literal: 767, second year. The Jiannan East Chuan circuit was abolished; a chief defense and observation commissioner concurrently holding the Jingrong Army commissioner post was established, with seat at Sui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 767, the Jiannan East Chuan circuit was abolished and replaced by a chief defense and observation commissioner who also served as Jingrong Army commissioner at Sui Prefecture.

translations.literal: Soon the military commissioner was again established, with seat at Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the military commissioner was restored, headquartered at Zi Prefecture.

translations.literal: 768 CE, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 768 CE, third year.

translations.literal: 769 CE, fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: 769 CE, fourth year.

sentences.zh: 770 五年 廢浙江東道節度使，置都團練守捉及觀察處置等使，領州如故。

translations.literal: 770, fifth year. The Zhejiang East circuit military commissioner was abolished; a chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner was established, holding the same prefectures as before.
translations.idiomatic: In 770, the Zhejiang East military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a chief training, garrison, observation, and disposal commissioner commanding the same prefectures.

sentences.zh: 771 六年 劍南東川節度罷領昌州。

translations.literal: 771, sixth year. The Jiannan East Chuan circuit discontinued jurisdiction over Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 771, the Jiannan East Chuan circuit relinquished Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廢福建節度使，置都團練觀察處置使。

translations.literal: The Fujian circuit military commissioner was abolished; a chief training, observation, and disposal commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a chief training, observation, and disposal commissioner.

translations.literal: 772 CE, seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 772 CE, seventh year.

translations.literal: 773 CE, eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: 773 CE, eighth year.

translations.literal: 774 CE, ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: 774 CE, ninth year.

sentences.zh: 775 十年 劍南東川節度復領昌州。

translations.literal: 775, tenth year. The Jiannan East Chuan circuit again took charge of Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 775, the Jiannan East Chuan circuit regained jurisdiction over Chang Prefecture.

translations.literal: 776 CE, eleventh year.
translations.idiomatic: 776 CE, eleventh year.

sentences.zh: 777 十二年 浙江西道觀察使罷領丹楊軍使。

translations.literal: 777, twelfth year. The Zhejiang West circuit observation commissioner discontinued the Danyang Army commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: In 777, the Zhejiang West observation commissioner relinquished the Danyang Army commissioner post.

translations.literal: The E Prefecture observation commissioner concurrently held the defense commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The E Prefecture observation commissioner also served as defense commissioner.

translations.literal: 778 CE, thirteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: 778 CE, thirteenth year.

sentences.zh: 779 十四年 合浙江東、西道置都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: 779, fourteenth year. The Zhejiang East and West circuits were combined under a chief training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 779, Zhejiang East and West were merged under a single chief training and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廢浙江東道都團練觀察使，以所管州隸浙江西道。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang East chief training and observation commissioner was abolished; its prefectures were placed under the Zhejiang West circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang East chief training and observation commissioner was abolished and its prefectures assigned to Zhejiang West.

sentences.zh: 廢宣歙池觀察使，置團練使。

translations.literal: The Xuan-She-Chi observation commissioner was abolished; a training commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuan–She–Chi observation commissioner was abolished and replaced by a training commissioner.

translations.literal: The E Prefecture observation and defense commissioner was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: The E Prefecture observation and defense commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 780 建中元年 分浙江東、西道都團練觀察使為二道。

translations.literal: 780, first year of the Jianzhong era. The Zhejiang East and West chief training and observation commissioner was divided into two circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In 780, the first year of Jianzhong, the combined Zhejiang East and West chief training and observation commissioner was split into two circuits.

sentences.zh: 復置浙江東道都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang East chief training and observation commissioner was again established.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang East chief training and observation commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 781 二年 淮南節度增領泗州。

translations.literal: 781, second year. The Huainan circuit added Si Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 781, the Huainan circuit gained jurisdiction over Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 合浙江東、西二道觀察置節度使，治潤州，尋賜號鎮海軍節度。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang East and West observation circuits were combined under a military commissioner, with seat at Run Prefecture; soon it was granted the title Zhenhai Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang East and West observation circuits were merged under a military commissioner at Run Prefecture, soon titled the Zhenhai Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 廢浙江東道都團練觀察使，以所管州隸浙江西道。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang East chief training and observation commissioner was abolished; its prefectures were placed under the Zhejiang West circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang East chief training and observation commissioner was abolished and its prefectures assigned to Zhejiang West.

translations.literal: Mian Prefecture was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: Mian Prefecture was abolished.

translations.literal: 782 CE, third year.
translations.idiomatic: 782 CE, third year.

sentences.zh: 783 四年 置壽州團練使。

translations.literal: 783, fourth year. A Shou Prefecture training commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 783, a Shou Prefecture training commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 升江南西道都防禦團練觀察使為節度使。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan West chief defense, training, and observation commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan West chief defense, training, and observation commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 復置鄂州都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The E Prefecture chief training and observation commissioner was again established.
translations.idiomatic: The E Prefecture chief training and observation commissioner was restored.

translations.literal: Mian Prefecture was again placed under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Mian Prefecture was restored to its command.

sentences.zh: 784 興元元年 閬州隸山南西道。

translations.literal: 784, first year of the Xingyuan era. Lang Prefecture was placed under the Shannan West circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 784, the first year of Xingyuan, Lang Prefecture was assigned to the Shannan West circuit.

sentences.zh: 淮南節度罷領濠、壽、廬三州。

translations.literal: The Huainan circuit discontinued jurisdiction over Hao, Shou, and Lu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan circuit relinquished Hao, Shou, and Lu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 升壽州團練使為都團練觀察使，領壽、濠、廬三州，治壽州。

translations.literal: The Shou Prefecture training commissioner was promoted to chief training and observation commissioner, holding Shou, Hao, and Lu prefectures—three in all—with seat at Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shou Prefecture training commissioner was raised to chief training and observation commissioner, commanding Shou, Hao, and Lu from his seat at Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 785 貞元元年 廢江南西道節度使，復置都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: 785, first year of the Zhenyuan era. The Jiangnan West circuit military commissioner was abolished; a chief training and observation commissioner was again established.
translations.idiomatic: In 785, the first year of Zhenyuan, the Jiangnan West circuit military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a restored chief training and observation commissioner.

translations.literal: 786 CE, second year.
translations.idiomatic: 786 CE, second year.

sentences.zh: 787 三年 分浙江東、西為二道，復置浙江西道都團練觀察使，領潤、江、常、蘇、杭、湖、睦七州，治蘇州。

translations.literal: 787, third year. Zhejiang East and West were divided into two circuits; the Zhejiang West chief training and observation commissioner was again established, holding Run, Jiang, Chang, Su, Hang, Hu, and Mu prefectures—seven in all—with seat at Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 787, Zhejiang East and West were split into two circuits; a Zhejiang West chief training and observation commissioner was restored, commanding Run, Jiang, Chang, Su, Hang, Hu, and Mu from his seat at Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 788 四年 淮南節度復領廬、壽二州，以泗州隸徐泗節度，廢壽州都團練觀察使為團練使。
